title: Chocolate Fudge
steps: Line a 20 cm square tin for the base batch, leaving paper over the sides. Keep the same mixture depth when scaling.
Put chocolate, condensed milk and butter in a heavy saucepan. Warm over very low heat, stirring constantly, until melted and smooth; do not boil.
Remove from heat, stir in vanilla and spread in the tin. Smooth the top.
Cool, then refrigerate for at least 4 hours until firm. Lift out and cut into the displayed number of pieces; keep refrigerated.

title: Peanut Brittle
desc: Crisp caramel shards packed with roasted peanuts.
steps: Line a heatproof tray with a silicone mat. Warm peanuts briefly in a dry pan over low heat and keep them ready.
Heat sugar, syrup and water in a deep heavy saucepan, stirring until sugar dissolves. Stop stirring and boil until a sugar thermometer reads 150°C.
Remove from heat and quickly stir in warm peanuts, butter, bicarbonate and vanilla. The mixture foams and is extremely hot.

Pour onto the mat and spread thinly with a heatproof spatula; never touch the hot caramel. Cool completely for 1 hour, then break into the displayed number of pieces and store airtight in a dry place.

title: Fruit & Nut Chocolate Bark
desc: Chilled chocolate shards with fruit, nuts and sea salt.
steps: Line a tray with baking paper.
Melt chocolate gently in a bowl over barely simmering water, keeping the bowl above the water and stirring until smooth.
Spread chocolate about 5 mm thick on the paper. Scatter with nuts, cranberries and salt, pressing them lightly into the chocolate.
Refrigerate for 1 hour until firm, then break into the displayed number of pieces. This untempered bark is best stored and served chilled.
